narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we will delve into the fascinating world of the human brain, exploring its intricate structure and diverse functions. We'll learn about its major parts and how they work together to control our body. Let's begin our journey into the command center of our body. First, let's understand what receptors are. Receptors are specialized tips of some nerve cells that receive information from our surroundings. They are primarily located in our sense organs. For example, gustatory receptors detect taste. The spinal cord, a crucial part of our central nervous system, is protected by the vertebral column, commonly known as the backbone. This bony structure ensures the safety of the delicate spinal cord.
